scenes.title: Fate's Surprise
scenes.summary: Max says that fate surprises us just when we think we control it. Chef then asks Timur for young lamb meat, complaining that yesterday's was bad.

scenes.title: Crash on the Street
scenes.summary: Elena apologizes to Chef Viktor, saying she did not see him. He is hurt, and she helps him up and offers to take him to the doctor.

scenes.title: The Alarm Clock
scenes.summary: Max and Sasha, tired in the morning, consider skipping work and snoozing the alarm. Sasha concludes they could be fired, so they get up.

scenes.title: A Torn Ligament
scenes.summary: A doctor tells Chef he has a partial ligament tear and should keep weight off the leg. Chef says a car hit him and he will not report it.

scenes.title: Betting on a Belt
scenes.summary: Senya complains the meat is tough as a shoe sole. Fedya says he ate boots in the navy and bets five thousand that he can eat Senya's belt.

scenes.title: The Leather Belt
scenes.summary: Fedya shows Senya a leather belt in the kitchen and says he will cook and eat it. Senya says nobody eats belts but agrees to watch.

scenes.title: The Stink in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Louis asks about a stink in the dining room. Senya says Fedya is boiling a belt because of a bet, and Chef tells them to go to work.

scenes.title: Sasha's Apology
scenes.summary: Sasha apologizes for something she did not mean to do and fears being fired. Max comforts her, says he will tell no one and tells her to keep working.

scenes.title: The Girl in Green
scenes.summary: Ilya asks Nastya whether a girl in a green dress was there. Nastya says she did not see her, and Ilya heads to the bar to look.

scenes.title: Without a Car
scenes.summary: Max and Sasha say they feel good together. Sasha offers to call him a taxi because he has no car and the subway is closed.

scenes.title: Riding Home
scenes.summary: Outside the restaurant after work, Max offers to catch a cab, but Sasha insists on driving him home while reminding him they are only friends.

scenes.title: Money for the Apartment
scenes.summary: Sasha lends Max the money he needs for rent, and Kostya teases Max when he finds out where the cash came from.

scenes.title: An Argument in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Fedya mocks Senya as Senya prepares to slice and eat a leather belt after losing their bet.

scenes.title: Important Business
scenes.summary: Viktor tricks Yelena into driving him through Moscow traffic for two hours just to buy watermelon chewing gum at a street kiosk.

scenes.title: The Forgotten Salad
scenes.summary: When guests complain about waiting for their order while Senya is away, Victoria and Max accidentally send Senya's belt salad to the dining room.

scenes.title: Where is My Salad?
scenes.summary: The cook asks his colleague about a missing dish he just prepared.

scenes.title: A Dissatisfied Guest
scenes.summary: A demanding guest complains about his food and demands to see the chef.

scenes.title: A Belt in the Salad
scenes.summary: A furious customer calls the waitress over after finding a belt in his turkey salad.

scenes.title: Quick Reaction
scenes.summary: Max thanks Sasha for saving him and then plays along with Vika's sarcastic joke.

scenes.title: Plans for the Evening
scenes.summary: A guest complains about the restaurant and Elena apologizes. Chef Viktor then asks Elena about her plans for tonight, and she likes his idea.

scenes.title: The Eaten Belt
scenes.summary: A guest says there was a belt in his salad. Fedya and Senya admit it came from a bet, and the guest tells them they are eating it.

scenes.title: The Price of a Bet
scenes.summary: Chef Viktor apologizes and asks for a drive. Fedya reminds Senya that he lost their five thousand bet, since a person could eat a belt.

scenes.title: Justice
scenes.summary: Timur tells Chef Viktor that Elena asked him to drive him. Max reflects that justice is giving someone their due, though life is complicated.
